title: 2026 Collaborative Fund Associate Program: Apply Now
gist: Collaborative Fund is hiring a two-year Investment Associate in New York for early-stage venture across Consumer, AI, Infra, Money, Health and Energy; essentially a job posting with little investable signal.

insights.claim: Collaborative Fund describes its investing as backing entrepreneurs pushing the world forward, seeking businesses with exceptional financial returns that also make the world better or more interesting, across Consumer, AI, Infra, Money, Health and Energy.
insights.speaker: Andrew Montgomery
insights.so_what: Indicates the fund's current early-stage thematic focus areas.

insights.claim: Collaborative Fund is recruiting a two-year Investment Associate in New York with roughly 3-5 years of experience, a primarily in-person role with travel to the Bay Area, to source, evaluate and support early-stage deals.
insights.speaker: Andrew Montgomery
insights.so_what: Minor signal that the fund is staffing up its early-stage sourcing.
